PK01.title: Monopolymer Polyethylene Design Guidelines
PK01.summary: Monopolymer PE structures simplify recycling streams and eliminate multi-material laminates.

PK02.title: Recycled Content Integration Standards
PK02.summary: Incorporating post-consumer recycled (PCR) resin reduces carbon footprint while maintaining barrier properties.

PK03.title: Outer Carton Elimination Impact
PK03.summary: Removing secondary paperboard cartons directly decreases packaging mass per unit without material reformulation.

PK04.title: Glass vs. Flexible Plastic Carbon Life Cycle
PK04.summary: Flexible pouches and mono-materials demonstrate significantly lower transport emissions than rigid glass.

PK05.title: Refillable Container Systems Assessment
PK05.summary: Refill models reduce single-use container waste across repeated consumer lifecycles.

PK06.title: Adhesive Impact on Sorting Efficiency
PK06.summary: Water-soluble and low-tack adhesives improve flake separation during recycling processing.

PK07.title: Rigid HDPE Density & Yield Optimization
PK07.summary: Optimizing wall thickness reduces resin consumption while passing drop-test requirements.

PK08.title: Aluminum Barrier Foil Recyclability
PK08.summary: Thin aluminum layers require mechanical separation testing to ensure compatibility with standard sorting streams.

PK09.title: Bio-based Polymer Performance Benchmark
PK09.summary: PLA and bio-PET offer compostable or renewable origins but require specific industrial composting infrastructure.

PK10.title: Secondary Packaging Shrink-Film Reduction
PK10.summary: Replacing secondary shrink wrap with banded multi-packs cuts polymer usage by up to 50%.

PK11.title: Closure & Pump Mechanism Recyclability
PK11.summary: Springless mono-material dispensing pumps prevent sorting contamination in automated material recovery facilities.

PK12.title: Supply Chain Distance & Weight Correlation
PK12.summary: Mass reduction directly correlates with freight fuel savings across distribution networks.

PK13.title: EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR)
PK13.summary: Mandates recyclability performance grades and strict limits on empty space ratios for commercial packaging.

PK14.title: Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) Fee Structures
PK14.summary: Fees scale proportionally with material recyclability grade and recycled content percentages.

PK15.title: Single-Use Plastics Directive Compliance
PK15.summary: Prohibits specific problematic polymers and enforces reduction targets for high-impact formats.

PK16.title: Green Claims Substantiation Standards
PK16.summary: Requires transparent, verifiable lifecycle data before marketing packaging as eco-friendly or sustainable.

PK17.title: Food-Contact Material Migration Limits
PK17.summary: Regulates chemical leachates and PCR purity thresholds for cosmetic and personal care contact layers.

PK18.title: Recycling Infrastructure Sorting Mandates
PK18.summary: Establishes automated optical sorting recognition standards for municipal recovery facilities.

PK19.title: Cross-Border Packaging Tax Frameworks
PK19.summary: Applies non-recyclable plastic packaging levies based on national weight quotas.
